articles.title: Maribyrnong I House / Studio Ceravolo
articles.summary: This alterations and additions project to a Californian bungalow welcomes an abundance of natural light and celebrates the passage of time throughout the day. Briefed with renovating and extending a Californian bungalow, we opted to move away from formal expectations and create a project attuned to the present and to the needs of a young family.

articles.title: Achime Bagel Store / JOJOWORKSHOP
articles.summary: Achime Bagel is a neighborhood bakery located in Munjeong-dong, Seoul . The project began with the idea of creating a small space that could gently accompany the beginning of each day. The bakery prepares and sells its bagels within the same day, and Jojo Workshop sought to translate this simple and diligent attitude into the interior.

articles.title: Hermitage House C70 / ASMD Taller Arquitectura
articles.summary: Ermita C70 transforms a 1960s house in the historic center of Mérida through an operation of subtraction: demolishing part of the built volume to recover the void as a source of light, ventilation, and social life.

articles.title: C.E. House / Dall'Ovo Magalhães Arquitetura
articles.summary: A mountain house that blurs the boundaries between living and contemplating. Sited on a plateau, between rolling lawns and the forest that climbs up the slope, the house sits as if it has belonged to the landscape for a long time. The horizontal, discreet, and elongated volume follows the natural slope of the ground — and it is precisely this simple decision that organizes the entire experience of the project: living close to the earth, yet suspended above it.

articles.title: São João Pharmacy / Tsou Arquitectos
articles.summary: Form The building takes on a clear, contained volume, distinguished by the curvilinear form of its façade — a gesture that follows the profile of the street and marks the building's presence on the corner it occupies. This curvature is not merely a plastic device: it is the element that functionally sets the volume apart from the surrounding residential fabric, giving it its own identity without breaking with the scale of the context. articles.title: Breeze House / Ábaton
articles.summary: Breeze House is a new construction project in Madrid that includes the most fundamental aspects of the ABATON philosophy. A modern house framed in nature and light that takes advantage of the characteristics of a plot with great potential to create a house that blends with its exterior.

articles.title: What is Blue Infrastructure? Rethinking Water's Role in City Design
articles.summary: Nature-based solutions are a primary strategy for contemporary climate adaptation and urban ecological resilience , embraced by cities regardless of their geography or climate zone . Green roofs, urban forests, bioswales, expanding tree canopy, protected wetlands, and permeable landscapes are featured prominently in municipal adaptation plans . These interventions are deployed across neighborhoods, distributed through street networks, and measured by hectares restored, trees planted, stormwater retained, or temperatures reduced. articles.title: Antiquity exhibition at Wawel castle / NArchitekTURA
articles.summary: The design of the exhibition 'Masterpieces from the Lanckoroński Collection: A Story of Antiquity' is an attempt to introduce unconventional, modern display methods into the historic architecture of Wawel. The concept is based on a stylistically cohesive arrangement of all the rooms, consistent in form but varied in the selection of colours and materials. This, in turn, creates an element of surprise and a gradual progression of impressions.
